annotations.title: See who a member can introduce you to

description: Return one member's full profile: who they can introduce the user to (role, company and details), what they are looking for themselves, industries, locations, university, and whether the user is already connected with them. Use this when the user wants to know more about a person from a search before asking for an introduction or referral, or asks "who is this" or "what can they help me with". Includes a card image that can be shown to the user.

claim_code.description: The claim_code from sign_up or sign_in, if the account is not connected in this conversation
